narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the rectangle will have a long side and a short side, like every rectangle.
<bookmark mark='long'/>Guessing from the rectangles we have seen can mislead us in this case.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>This rectangle has a special angle at its diagonal, so build it and measure every side.

narration: <bookmark mark='sides'/>To check, measure all four sides and every corner of your figure.
<bookmark mark='angle'/>Then measure the diagonal's angle with each side. Both should read forty five degrees.
